root_causes.root_cause: RFC-022 B2 Part A (extension-based content_class='image_standalone' override for _IMAGE_EXTS files after route_and_extract_flat) was marked complete in task tracker but never implemented in client.py. Bare .jpg files go through route_and_extract_flat which classifies them as flat_prose/flat_mixed (OCR text creates prose blocks, not all role='image'), so the all(b.get('role')=='image') check at line 1606 fails. Without image_standalone content_class, classify_verdict hits the flat_prose promotion gate where 489 chars < 500 MIN_IMAGE_PROMOTED_CHARS char floor, yielding MARGINAL/image_enrichment_promoted_below_char_floor instead of routing through _classify_image_verdict (which has no char floor).
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add extension-based content_class override in client.py after line 1608 (the existing image_standalone detection block): when ext in _IMAGE_EXTS and _IMAGE_STANDALONE_PIPELINE_ENABLED, force content_class='image_standalone' regardless of what route_and_extract_flat returned. This is exactly the fix specified in RFC-022 B2 Part A that was never landed. With this fix, classify_verdict routes through _classify_image_verdict(image_enrichment_ratio) at helpers.py:1522 which returns PASS when ratio>=0.8 (the pie chart has ratio=1.0).
